items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And I fired Lloyd, the leader of the band, that night.

ctx.x: And I got mad, and I started cussing out Lloyd Hunter and all of the guys that was drunk. And I

And I told them, him, and everybody else they were fired. And I fired Lloyd, the leader of the band, that night. And he said, 'Okay, well, I'll just take my horn and go.' And he packed his horn up and walked out the door, and got outside, and it struck him that that was his band, and I fired him. And he came back in and said, 'You can't fire me, I'm the leader of this band.' I was the youngest thing in the band, really. And I fired him. And then he came back in, they finished their gig, and he started thinking…
